name: pcb-visualizer
description: Front end, tests and desktop tooling of PCB Visualizer, a local workbench for documenting the debug interfaces of hardware you own.

scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude='**/tests/**' --test-coverage-exclude='app/vendor/**' app/tests/*.test.mjs && cd service && uv run pytest -rs --cov=pcbv --cov-report=term
scripts.service: cd service && uv run pcbv serve
scripts.vendor: mkdir -p app/vendor/xterm && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/lib/xterm.js node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css node_modules/@xterm/addon-fit/lib/addon-fit.js app/vendor/xterm/ && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/LICENSE app/vendor/xterm/LICENSE
scripts.lint:py: cd service && uv run ruff check src tests
